_comment: Controlled vocabulary for Stage 4 name/term correction. Seeded ahead of Stage 4 build-out -- known_asr_variants are observed mishearings to correct on sight; add more as they turn up across sources (Zoom transcript, YouTube captions, Whisper).

Confirmed via full-corpus survey 2026-09-18 (647 legit "expressionism"/"impressionism" references excluded by not matching those bare words -- only tech/tex/tax/text-prefixed and merged forms are misspellings of this term).

Protective entry, not a misspelling fix: this ordinary phrase (Salon 109, Roz Dimon) fuzzy-matches Salon 109's own participant 'Beau Tardy Artist' closely enough (0.76 ratio, exact match on the trailing word 'artist') to get auto-corrected INTO that name by correct_names_in_text()'s strong-prior pass, silently reverting Colin's 2026-09-22 correction on every rebuild. Being a recognized vocabulary canonical makes it 'known_good', which lib_corrections.py's auto-correction branch now also respects (previously only suppressed the review-CSV row, not the correction itself).
